'''Manalo Stadium''' (Japanese: '''マナーロ・スタジアム''' ''Manalo Stadium'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive {{wp|very large floating structure}} in the [[Alola]] [[region]] found near [[Aether Paradise]].

It was built by the [[Aether Foundation]] to host Alola's first {{pkmn|League Conference}}. It first appeared in ''[[SM115|The Dealer of Destruction!]]'' while it was still in construction, when {{an|Professor Kukui}} announced the [[Alola League]]. The construction was completed in ''[[SM127|Chasing Memories, Creating Dreams!]]''.

It reappeared in ''[[SM128|League Offenders and Defenders!]]'' as some of the entrants for the [[Manalo Conference]] signed up and explored some of the stadium's sights. The tournament itself began in the [[SM129|next episode]] and concluded in ''[[SM139|Enter the Champion!]]''. The award ceremony was unexpectedly interrupted by the appearance of a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Manalo Stadium Guzzlord|Guzzlord}}. {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Shiny Guzzlord|Two more Guzzlord}} appeared from other wormholes in the [[SM140|next episode]], but all three [[Pokémon category|Junkivore Pokémon]] were successfully sent back to [[Ultra Space]] by the end of the episode.

Following the Guzzlord incident, the stadium also hosted an {{wp|Exhibition game|exhibition match}} between Professor Kukui and the Manalo Conference winner. The match started in ''[[SM141|Exhibition Unmasked!]]'' and ended in ''[[SM144|From Z to Shining Z!]]'', bringing the Manalo Conference to an end along with it.

Besides the battlefield, the stadium also houses a [[Pokémon Center]], a shopping mall, and multiple restaurants and food trucks.
